tests.name: SDF validation and installed launch arguments
IMU typo reproduced and fixed with one bridge
Live frames, offered QoS and measured frequencies
Matching ROS/Gazebo commands and physical body/wheel motion
Live stale and NaN refusal; no raw command bypass
Preserved odometry and matching tf stamp/pose
MCAP read: 32.935 simulation seconds, seven nonempty topics

defect.reproducer: Launch with config/bridge-defect.yaml; compare ROS info, timed echo and gz topic for IMU.
defect.root_cause: The Gazebo source is /vehicle/imu, but the bridge subscribes to /vehicle/imu_typo. A ROS publisher is visible without receiving source data.
defect.proof_after: Stop the defect launch and start normal bridge.yaml once. IMU arrives with imu_link and simulation stamps; headless runtime, seven-topic MCAP and physical motion checks pass.
